title: Google Analytics
description: Add your Google Analytics tracking code to all user interface pages.

settings_def.name: ga_property_id
settings_def.label: Google Analytics Tracking IDDQD
settings_def.description: Enter your Tracking ID here. This will look like: UA-00000000-1.

settings_def.name: ga_property_demographics_reports
settings_def.label: Enable Demographics and Interests Reports
settings_def.description: Demographics and Interest Reports make Age, Gender, and Interest data available so you can better understand who your users are.

settings_def.label: Use enhanced link attribution
settings_def.description: Enhanced link attribution allows to better track links on your page.
